verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a SaaS collaboration product that stores user content, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no statement about whether customer data is used to train AI models, and no setting to opt out. The MCP, CLI and AI-agent integration items describe connecting AI tools to Basecamp, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
